selected_evidence.summary: Generated /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_host_ca ed25519 CA keypair with root-only permissions

selected_evidence.requirement: Host certificate signed by the CA and installed
selected_evidence.summary: Signed ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub with the CA producing ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub, configured HostCertificate in sshd_config.d, validated config, restarted ssh, confirmed listening on :22

selected_evidence.requirement: Client trusts CA (not pinned host key) and connects without pinning
selected_evidence.summary: known_hosts contained only an @cert-authority line (no pinned host key); ssh with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes reported 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate', failing only later on publickey auth
Captured boot_id bfd05127-... and confirmed ssh.socket/ssh active plus cert files present before reboot
systemd-run scheduled systemctl reboot and returned 'REBOOT_SCHEDULED' acknowledgement immediately

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Connection dropped mid-command during reboot, then reconnection showed new boot_id 56c34e23-... differing from baseline bfd05127-...

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and cert data
selected_evidence.summary: ssh.socket active and listening on :22, CA and host-cert files intact, and CA-trust-only client verification again succeeded post-reboot
